sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production BASE COLOR texture for a UV-unwrapped rounded aerospace SSTO vehicle. Generate a square 2048x2048 full-frame seamless flat material swatch of warm ivory off-white ceramic-coated spacecraft metal, fine restrained painted micrograin, extremely subtle warm grey variation, occasional tiny edge-independent hairline scratches and pinprick freckles. Broad mostly clean areas, gently used and meticulously maintained, restrained hand-painted game art with physically plausible fine surface color. Entire image is uniformly the same material and planar texture, top-down orthographic, completely diffuse neutral unlit albedo, uniform exposure everywhere. No objects, no spacecraft, no shapes, no panels, no borders, no perspective, no gradients, no lighting, no shadows, no highlights, no text, no logos, no grid. The result will wrap onto curved ivory hull geometry; panel borders are modeled separately. Make the texture quiet and subtle, not grungy.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production BASE COLOR texture for blue-gray protective armor on a rounded spacecraft. Generate a square 2048x2048 edge-to-edge seamless flat material swatch, desaturated medium slate blue aerospace enamel over metal, average sRGB color approximately #55748a, extremely fine ceramic paint grain, restrained tone variation, sparse very fine maintenance scratches, a few tiny pale flecks. Clean cared-for ship with subtle authentic wear, soft stylized game-art finish, not dirty or corroded. Entire canvas is a single uniform planar surface, orthographic top-down, unlit diffuse ALBEDO ONLY. Absolutely no baked lighting, shadows, highlights, color gradient, panels, seams, frames, objects, perspective, spacecraft, symbols, text, logos or borders. Restrained blue-gray, never bright cyan. The panel shapes and seams will be modeled separately in 3D.
